title: Sections 234B & 234C Interest: Defaults and Deferments of Advance Tax
text: Sections 234B and 234C enforce timely compliance with advance tax obligations. Section 234B triggers if a taxpayer whose advance tax liability exceeds Rs. 10,000 either fails to pay any advance tax or pays less than 90% of the assessed tax before the close of the financial year. Simple interest at 1% per month is charged from April 1st of the assessment year until regular assessment or self-assessment date. Section 234C penalizes deferment or shortfalls in quarterly advance tax installments: 15% due by June 15, 45% by Sept 15, 75% by Dec 15, and 100% by March 15. Shortfall interest under 234C is assessed at 1% per month for three months on the deferred amounts across each quarter. Presumptive taxpayers under Section 44AD/44ADA pay their entire advance tax in one installment by March 15, escaping 234C quarterly penalties if paid in full.
